user.title: Add a cluster light
user.description: Pick a light Home Assistant has already heard, or enter its Bluetooth address by hand. These strings advertise only every 16-28 seconds, so an empty list usually means 'not heard yet' rather than 'not there'.

confirm.title: Add {name}
confirm.description: Found {name} at {address}. Add it to Home Assistant?

error.invalid_address: That is not a Bluetooth address. Expected six hex pairs separated by colons, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

abort.already_configured: This light is already set up.
